items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: But then they began to have them hassles among themselves. You see, after Dutre and Dodd found out that Joe had substituted New Orleans and Atkins, well that caused hard feelings. The band busted up soon. And Johnny Dodd was taking the man into this place over there.

ctx.x: You never heard him play? No, as I know of.

A lot of guys I heard play I didn't know who they were, you know, as a kid I didn't know who they were. He was up in Chicago. He just sounded good and I ran behind him, huh? He was up in Chicago too. Well he might have, evidently. They made a hit in New York and everywhere they went. That was some different kind of music you know. And the people just went for it. Just like Chicago they ate it up. Big crowds wherever they played. Three or four bands playing in the places, the Lord of the Lord, the Tony Jacksons…
